Data source

The graph and its SQL companions are served directly from Cloudflare R2 with browser-visible HTTP Range and CORS headers. No proxy, redirect, or token is involved.

The same Wikidata slice in four lossless encodings on Cloudflare R2. Every query below fetches only the bytes it touches - nothing is downloaded whole. Pick a backend; the example buttons load the analogous query for it. Type tables are named by Q-id (Q5=human, Q16521=taxon).
